en.headline: ICAC charges six including former Cyberport section head over subsidy fraud
en.dek: The Independent Commission Against Corruption alleges bribery and conspiracy involving about HK$20 million in government technology grants.
body: The Independent Commission Against Corruption has charged six people, including a former section head of Hong Kong Cyberport Management Company Limited, in connection with alleged bribery and fraud over government technology subsidies.

The ICAC said the charges followed Operation Thunderclap, which targeted a syndicate suspected of offering and accepting advantages and defrauding the Digital Transformation Support Pilot Programme. The six appeared at Eastern Magistrates’ Courts on Monday for mention; no plea was entered and the case was adjourned to 4 January 2027, with the defendants granted bail.

Alice So Nga-lai, 59, then Head of Entrepreneurship at Cyberport, faces one count of public servant accepting advantages. Viola Lam Yuen-lee, 39, sole proprietor of an information technology company, faces one count of offering advantages to a public servant. Lam and four others face a joint charge of conspiracy to defraud.

The ICAC said the alleged offences occurred between October 2023 and January 2026. Cyberport acted as secretariat for the pilot programme. Investigators found at least 400 applications involving about HK$20 million in subsidies. The remaining defendants include Lam’s brother and three downline vendors.
All defendants are presumed innocent until proven guilty. The ICAC said it continues to work with government departments on integrity measures for subsidy schemes.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴數碼港前總監等六人涉貪及詐騙資助
zh.dek: 廉政公署指涉案人士涉嫌行賄受賄及串謀詐騙，涉款約2000萬元數碼轉型支援先導計劃資助。
body: 廉政公署已落案起訴六人，包括香港數碼港管理有限公司時任創業家總監，涉嫌就政府科技資助計劃行賄受賄及串謀詐騙。
廉署表示，案件源於「雷鳴」行動，針對涉嫌透過行賄受賄及造假手段詐騙「數碼轉型支援先導計劃」資助的不法集團。六名被告周一在東區裁判法院提訊，暫毋須答辯，案件押後至2027年1月4日再訊，各人獲准保釋。
59歲被告蘇雅麗為數碼港時任創業家總監，被控一項公職人員接受利益罪。39歲被告林苑莉為資訊科技公司獨資東主，被控一項向公職人員提供利益罪。林苑莉與其餘四名被告，包括其弟弟及三名下線推銷商，另被控一項串謀詐騙罪。
廉署指涉案期間為2023年10月至2026年1月。數碼港當時擔任計劃秘書處。調查發現涉案申請最少400宗，涉及資助約2000萬元。
所有被告在法庭定罪前均被推定無罪。廉署表示會繼續與政府部門合作，加強資助計劃的防貪措施。
